statements.subject: server
statements.description: The Get Extended Agent Card operation MUST require authentication
actions: Require authentication before processing the Get Extended Agent Card operation

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Agents MUST authenticate requests using one of the schemes declared in the public AgentCard.securitySchemes and AgentCard.security fields
actions: Authenticate incoming requests using one of the schemes declared in AgentCard.securitySchemes and AgentCard.security fields

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Agents MAY return different extended card content based on the authenticated client's identity or authorization level
actions: Return different extended card content based on the authenticated client's identity or authorization level

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Agents SHOULD implement appropriate caching headers to control client-side caching of extended cards
actions: Include appropriate caching headers in the extended agent card response to control client-side caching

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Extended cards MAY include additional skills not present in the public card
actions: Include additional skills in the extended card that are not present in the public agent card

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Extended cards MAY expose more detailed capability information (e.g., rate limits, quotas)
actions: Expose more detailed capability information such as rate limits and quotas in the extended card

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Extended cards MAY include organization-specific or user-specific configuration
actions: Include organization-specific or user-specific configuration in the extended card

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Agents SHOULD document which capabilities are available at different authentication levels
actions: Document which capabilities are available at each authentication level

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Extended cards SHOULD NOT include sensitive information that could be exploited if leaked (e.g., internal service URLs, unmasked credentials)
actions: Exclude sensitive information such as internal service URLs and unmasked credentials from extended cards

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Agents MUST validate that clients have appropriate permissions before returning privileged information in extended cards
actions: Validate that the client has appropriate permissions before returning privileged information in the extended card

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients retrieving extended cards SHOULD replace their cached public Agent Card with the extended version for the duration of their authenticated session
actions: Replace the cached public Agent Card with the extended card for the duration of the authenticated session

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Agents SHOULD version extended cards appropriately and honor client cache invalidation

statements.subject: server
statements.description: When capabilities.extendedAgentCard is false or not present, the operation MUST return UnsupportedOperationError
actions: Return UnsupportedOperationError when capabilities.extendedAgentCard is false or not present

statements.subject: server
statements.description: When support is declared but no extended card is configured, the operation MUST return ExtendedAgentCardNotConfiguredError
actions: Return ExtendedAgentCardNotConfiguredError when extended card support is declared but no extended card is configured
